title: Settings

general.webhookPortHint: All workflow webhooks share this port; changes take effect immediately. URLs of enabled webhooks change their port — external callers must update
general.webhookPortInvalid: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535

permission.keepAwakeDesc: Keep the device awake while the screen is locked, so remote control and background agent tasks keep running
permission.autoLaunchDesc: Tianshu will start automatically after you log in to your computer
permission.autoInstallTrustedSkillsDesc: Install automatically once security checks pass; high-risk items always require manual confirmation
permission.autoUpdateSkillsDesc: Automatically update installed skills to the latest version; skills you have edited in Tianshu are never updated

storage.cacheDirectoryDesc: Stores app data: database, skills, library, logs and more
storage.workspacePathDesc: New tasks and workspaces are stored under this path; existing data is not affected
storage.dataRootRestartPending: Data directory updated. Restart to apply; data will be copied to the new location on first launch (original kept as backup)
storage.relaunchFailed: Restart failed, please restart the app manually
storage.dataRootNested: New directory cannot be inside the current data directory
storage.dataRootNotAbsolute: Data directory must be an absolute path

executionHistory.title: Run History Retention
executionHistory.desc: Automatically clean scheduled task and workflow run records; trace data is cleaned before records to prevent unbounded growth

backupDesc: Pack the local database and assets (skills, library, etc.) and upload them to the selected host, for migration or disaster recovery
backupRestoreConfirmBody: A safety copy of your current data will be kept automatically (backups-local/ in the data directory). Restart the app after the restore completes to apply it.
backupDeleteConfirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
backupOnlyDirect: Backups only support direct connections. Add or enable a direct host on the Hosts page first
backupRelaunching: Restore complete. Restart the app to apply
backupClaimDesc: Claim a backup identity for this connection with a one-time invite code from the admin; the backup token is filled in automatically on success
backupClaimSuccess: Claimed; the backup token has been filled in automatically
backupClaimStaleHint: The current backup identity may be invalid; claiming again will overwrite it automatically
backupAdminDesc: Generate invite codes for other devices to claim backup identities, and manage claimed devices

notification.desktopDesc: Get system alerts when tasks finish or new messages arrive
notification.testBody: Desktop notifications are on. You will be alerted here when tasks finish or new messages arrive.
notification.testSent: Test notification sent. If it doesn't appear, check notification permissions in system settings
notification.clientDesc: Operational messages are shown in-app first, and switch to desktop notifications once the app goes to the background

error.testNotificationFailed: Failed to send test notification, please try again

welcomeLoading.label: Loading greetings
welcomeLoading.desc: Show rotating greetings while the AI is taking longer to respond

fileChangeDetails.label: Show file operation details
fileChangeDetails.desc: Expand file tool steps in real time; history messages stay collapsed

customInstructions.label: Custom instructions
customInstructions.desc: Global rules appended to every conversation
customInstructions.placeholder: e.g. Lead with the conclusion; always use Python examples

userNickname.label: What Tianshu calls you
userNickname.desc: How the AI addresses you in conversations

aiName.label: Tianshu's name
aiName.desc: How the AI refers to itself; default is Tianshu

persona.label: Persona description
persona.desc: The AI's underlying system prompt: worldview and behavior
persona.empty: Not set — click edit to enable

memory.label: Long-term memory
memory.desc: Facts the AI should always remember, injected every turn
memory.empty: Nothing yet — click edit to add

editor.unsavedBody: Your edits will be lost if you close now.

shortcut.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to restore all shortcuts to their defaults?
shortcut.invalidBinding: Invalid key combination. Combine it with a modifier key (Cmd/Ctrl, Alt), or use keys like Enter/Esc
shortcut.conflictMessage: This combination is already used by "{{name}}". Replace it?
shortcut.conflictFixed: This combination is reserved by the fixed shortcut "{{name}}" and cannot be replaced
shortcut.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this shortcut binding?
shortcut.systemWarning: This is a system-level combination and may be intercepted by the OS

memory.title: Memory & Evolution
memory.description: When enabled, Tianshu extracts contextual information from your conversations to build a personalized memory about you, so it can respond in a way that better fits your needs. See the privacy policy for details.

toggle.label: Conversation Memory
toggle.desc: Allow Tianshu to extract context from conversations and build personalized memory for more precise responses.

model.label: Memory Compilation Model
model.desc: Choose the model for automatic memory compilation. Leave empty to auto-select from default/enabled models.

manage.title: Manage Memory
manage.subtitle: Memory is compiled and updated automatically every night

edit.instructionPlaceholder: Enter an instruction to adjust memory, e.g. Remember I'm in Xiamen / Delete weather-related memories

resetDialog.title: Reset Memory
resetDialog.warning1: This will erase all memories and cannot be undone.
resetDialog.warning2: If Conversation Memory stays enabled, new memories will still be generated afterwards.
resetDialog.warning3: To disable it completely, turn off Conversation Memory.

memory.disabledNotice: Conversation Memory is off; memory content will no longer update automatically

toast.importFallback: No section headings recognized; all content was saved under Work Background
toast.instructionFailed: Failed to apply the memory instruction
toast.copyFailed: Copy failed; please select and copy manually

error.MEMORY_MODEL_MISSING: No model available; configure one in provider settings first

error.MEMORY_NO_MATERIAL: No conversation content available to compile yet
